A '''reanimated abyssal demon''' can be spawned by casting the [[Arceuus spellbook|spell]] [[Master Reanimation]] on an [[ensouled abyssal head]]. The spell can be cast within a 31x31 area where the head was dropped by a monster. This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the [[bank]], [[trade]] screen, [[Grand Exchange]], or [[price checker]]. If the player has done one of these things, they will no longer be able to reanimate the abyssal demon in the area where it was killed, but can still reanimate it within range of the [[Dark Altar]]. Killing the creature will grant the player 1,300 [[Prayer]] [[experience]].

Level 85 [[Slayer]]{{Boostable|yes}} is required to inflict damage to this monster. Unlike regular [[Abyssal demon|abyssal demons]], they cannot teleport themselves or the player around.

Reanimated abyssal demons may drop [[brimstone key]]s whilst slain in the appropriate location while on a [[Konar]] Slayer task.
